reviews.title: Finally Fix!
reviews.text:
Edit: 10.11.26
I did finally find the fix for this. I would set an alarm and it would last for about a week. 
After months of searching, I finally saw the option when setting an alarm, to select WeekCal as an option under calendar. 
I had already added it as a calendar in my phone. Now, that I am selecting it when I set the alarm. Everything works great. 
………………….
 I have had this app for years. For years, it was my go to for scheduling my day to day life. No alarms go off. I paid for the “no ad” version years ago.

reviews.title: Terrible subscription plan. Do not buy.
reviews.text: I bought the Basic subscription (€29.99 per year), but it's practically unusable: it prompts me to upgrade to a more expensive plan every ten seconds. I wish I were kidding. When I contacted support, they first claimed the issue had been fixed in an app update, but later said it happens because the month view isn't included in the cheapest plan. I ended up getting a refund through Apple.

reviews.text:
The circular hell of customer support that isn’t really customer support is beyond aggravating. I updated this app, and now every single time I touch the screen, I’m prompted to pay for PRO, even though I paid for this app years ago.

I should not have to repeatedly dismiss upgrade prompts for a product I already purchased, nor should an update effectively take away functionality I previously paid for. This is intrusive, frustrating, and completely unacceptable.

Please fix this issue and restore my paid access without the constant PRO prompts.

reviews.title: WARNING!!! LOST ALL ENTRIES TWICE!!!!!!
reviews.text: I have used this app for at least 10 years if not more and have absolutely loved it!! Never any issues whatsoever until about a year and a half ago, I pulled up my calendar and EVERYTHING was GONE…past, present, and future!! I contacted the developer and they said it had something to do with the native iPhone calendar overwriting the app’s entries. They offered some suggestions on how I could possibly restore my data. However, I tried everything that was still possible with no success. Because I love the app so much I came to terms with the devastating loss and moved forward. While I had not fully recovered from the loss of recurring annual entries such as detailed birthday input, anniversaries, special dates etc I was on my way to rebuilding my calendar for scheduling purposes. But then a couple days ago I pulled up my calendar and EVERY page and view was BLANK AGAIN!!! I turned my phone off and on multiple times thinking that a restart might solve it but still blank. This morning I decided to delete the app and reinstall. However, once app was deleted and reinstalled I was not able to get past a subscription page to access my calendar now. I paid for an upgrade years ago to have advanced features, but when I hit restore, I got a “Restored” message but the subscription page did not go away. After having lost ALL of my data TWICE all trust of this app is gone!! I would not pay any amount of money to have it at this point! Was debating whether or not to even stay with it perio

reviews.title: Early adopter, one time paid subscriber, now extorted for future improvements
reviews.text: ***Edit: I wrote this review originally on 5/30/26, mentioning the $160 “unlock all” option. It was listed at the time of writing, and now - three days later - that option has also been removed. No response from devs. This goes to my point about their money hungry ways. OG Review follows next. // No longer worth it. I was an early adopter and paid a one-time upgrade fee for PRO in 2012. I was to have access to everything and all future upgrades. Now that prices have gone up, they are extorting me to upgrade to a subscription, when I already paid my dues as an early adopter. Even the one-time “everything unlocked” upgrade has increased 80x to $159.99.  I already paid for my one time access to everything, but they are money hungry wanting early adopters to pay more. Now every time I open my app and try to do something, it takes me to, and locks me on, the upgrade screen. I have “restored” successfully repeatedly, but it does nothing. I had recommended this app countless times over the years, but it’s worthless to me now. They do not appreciate customers who made them the success they are today. Searching for new product.

reviews.title: Another annoying glitch showed up today
reviews.text:
What happened to purple? This morning, the color hues have changed! I use multiple calendars that are color-coded and I use purple for my default calendar. Today, my purple suddenly appears burgundy. It was fine last night. The color choice still says purple, but the hue has changed. 

And a long-time annoyance is that every time I go to another month besides the current month, all my events are gone until I swipe forward or back from that month. The dots indicating an event is recorded are (usually, but not yesterday) there, but no labels , times or details visible. 

On my husband’s phone, this calendar app will not retain events longer than 6 months from the current date. That means he can’t identify any event longer ago than 6 months and he can’t schedule any event or appointment further out than 6 months. Our work is seasonal and cyclical, so historical data is important. And clients like to schedule their appointments with us a year out. On my phone, I can do that in this app, but on his, he cannot, even though all settings are identical. 

We’ve used this app for many years and it just keeps becoming more bothersome! How many more annoyances are we going to get?

reviews.title: Good but flawed
reviews.text:
This is the best calendar I have tried. However, there is one longterm bug and one needed feature lacking.
1.  When unlocking the iPhone or iPad, the 7 days/dates titles at the top of each column are gone. You have to swipe back or forward one week and then return to the current week for the days/dates to appear. App support is aware of this bug and told me to just swipe?!?! to get the days/dates to show up.
2. There is no option to automatically have the current day move to the left side at midnight. App support is also aware of this and told me I should not expect an option will ever be offer to do this.  
Poor customer support on these 2 issues.

reviews.title: Scam links took over my calendar. Absolute trash. Latest iOS update wiped my events
reviews.text:
Best to rely on an analogue calendar. Latest iOS update erased all the data from my calendar. I will have to call people to find out again when my appointment is. Letters on buttons overlap now at the bottom of the screen and the upper left corner, clearly something has gone wrong. Loved the layout, not found any other calendar app that is a full month view and properly rases the alarm for events. Really annoyed this was very practical. I struggle with memory issues and this calendar was extremely helpful, now unusable and empty.

Update: as of now I have every day full of pfishing links. Basically the app os a scam vehicle. What the heck?!
